description: The exact structure of a feature spec (feature-template.md). The engine checks every draft against it before the spec leaves the interview (F-016 FR-17) and names each heading or table header that differs. Keep it in step with feature-template.md.
extra_sections: Any other level-2 section (for example ## Sources or ## 13. Open questions) goes after section 12. Level-3 and lower headings may appear inside any section.
